subject: MAP draft & stakeholder ownership — next steps and role confirmations
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@edgewave.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@edgewave.com>, Tom Becker <tom.becker@edgewave.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP draft & stakeholder ownership — next steps and role confirmations

Hi team — great call today, thanks everyone for the time. Per our discussion I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and pulled out the milestones, owners, target close date and dependencies so we have a single source of truth for the next 10 weeks. Please see the high-level items below and the attached workbook for the milestone table.

Quick MAP highlights (see tab "Milestones"):
- Target commercial close: 2027-02-11 (target close for procurement + legal sign-off)
- Pilot kickoff: 2027-01-03 (pilot scope: search augmentation, 50k monthly tokens)
- Security assessment complete: 2026-12-15 (includes SOC2 checklist & infra review)
- Integration validation: 2027-01-20 (engineering test plan + staging performance run)

Proposed owners (please confirm):
- Economic buyer: Liam O'Connor (budget & procurement)
- Security owner: Priya Shah (vetted for compliance evidence needs)
- Legal owner: Priya Shah (primary for contract redlines)
- Engineering lead: Tom Becker (integration, perf validation)

Dependencies called out in the MAP:
- Redwood to provide security questionnaire + sample audit logs (attached 'security-questionnaire-edgewave.pdf')
- EdgeWave to provide SAML metadata and a staging environment by 2026-12-10
- Procurement: PO template requested; Elastic terms conversation to be scheduled if needed

Next steps / asks: 
1) Can you confirm the owners above and surface any other stakeholders who must be included in the RACI? (e.g., procurement contact, ops lead) — please reply by EOD 2026-12-02.
2) Karthik / Marissa: we will need a succinct SOW excerpt for pilot scope by 2026-12-08 so procurement can start paperwork.
3) Liam: is the proposed target close realistic from your side or should we push to late Feb?

Attachments: EdgeWave_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (xlsx) — milestone tab, responsibilities, timeline; security-questionnaire-edgewave.pdf (pdf) — initial ask list.

Thanks — I will update the MAP with any confirmations and send a signed-off version.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0126

Thanks Stephanie — appreciate the clear recap and the draft MAP. Quick confirmations from my side:
- Economic buyer: confirmed (myself) — procurement looped (PO lead will be Sara Nguyen, copied on follow-up threads).
- Target close: Feb 11 feels tight but doable if we get the security assessment complete by 12/15 and receive the SAML metadata by 12/10. If either slips we should nudge the close to 2027-02-25.
